title: invocation-context-enricher-and-compact-cost-drift-panel
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: We observed noisy long-tail alerting and poor signal in SLO investigations where traces lacked stable invocation context (caller annotations, client SDK version, and prompt-shape bucket). This PR introduces an invocation context enricher in the telemetry pipeline, a compact cost-drift dashboard panel for fast triage, and an alert decorrelator to reduce duplicate notifications from correlated token-cost spikes. The description below summarizes motivation, what changed, CI notes, and rollout plan. Motivation: SRE and platform engineers spend too long correlating traces with billing spikes; many incidents are repeated across downstream callers with identical upstream characteristics. The enricher creates a compact, stable context fingerprint (invocation_family) using hashed callsite, sdk metadata, model variant tag, and prompt-shape bucket. It is sampled and attached to spans and metrics as a low-cardinality tag to enable rollups without exploding cardinality. What changed: 1) pkg/observability/enricher/context_enricher.go: new pipeline stage that hydrates a sampled context bundle and attaches invocation_family, prompt_shape, sdk_version, and client_region on sampled spans and on a low-volume metrics stream. 2) internal/telemetry/transformers/token_cost_labeler.go: minor changes to include invocation_family for cost rollups and to emit compact cost drift markers. 3) dashboards/compact_cost_drift_panel.json: new Grafana panel that shows per-invocation_family cost drift sparkline and a compact histogram for last-24h to speed triage. 4) alerting/decorrelator/config.yaml: new adaptive decorrelator configs that group alerts by invocation_family and suppress duplicates when overlap > 80% and within 15 minutes. 5) webapp/src/components/CostDriftChart.tsx: UI for the sparkline and on-hover attribution. 6) tests/integration/test_context_enricher.py + unit tests. High-level commits: "init: add invocation context enricher and basic sampler"; "feat: emit invocation_family on metrics and spans"; "ui: add compact cost drift panel and hover attribution"; "feat: alerting: adaptive decorrelator config and implementation"; "test: add unit and integration tests"; "chore: CI fixes and lints". Files changed (high level): context enricher code, metric labeler changes, alert decorrelator config and small engine change, new dashboard JSON, small UI component, docs and tests. Review conversation summary: - Omar: "This looks good overall; can we keep invocation_family stable across minor SDK bumps?" Author: "Yes — enricher normalizes sdk_version to major.minor and drops patch; we added a migration note in docs." - Linnea: "Concern about cardinality when users send custom client_region. Can we cap to known regions?" Author: "We whitelist regions from config with fallback 'other' — updated config and tests." - Greg: "Alert decorrelator: please add backoff logic for repeated suppression in 24h window." Author: "Added exponential backoff per invocation_family; tests included." CI summary: pipeline ran full unit + integration suite; one flaky UI test (CostDriftChart hover) failed on first run, was retried by pipeline and passed; all other checks green. Merge: squash and merge by Maya Chen after approvals from Omar and Linnea and addressing comments. Rollout plan: deployed pipeline change to staging on 2026-02-25 behind feature flag OBS_ENRICHER=staging; dashboards added to Grafana staging folder; alert decorrelator enabled in staging alert manager. Gradual rollout: enable low-sample mode (0.5%) for 48h, monitor metric cardinality and alert volumes, ramp to 5% then 25% if stable. Migration notes: historic metrics remain unchanged; new invocation_family label only appears on sampled spans and new metrics stream; cost rollups for billing use stable mapping to invocation_family (documented). Backwards compatibility: all changes are additive; no API break. Additional notes: added a short doc docs/observability/context-enrichment.md with configuration knobs, sampling guidance, and troubleshooting steps.
